title: Fulfillment Note — Collection Method and the Card Allowance on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Rule.** On an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements paid in cash or through an outside lender, the card allowance follows how the vehicle is collected at the order's handover appointment. The collection method is the fulfillment method of the order's appointment in Delivery & Pickup Appointments.

| Handover appointment | Card allowance |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | rises by $400.00 (the staffed-pickup uplift) |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | falls by $500.00 (the contactless reduction) |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive, Kestrel Local Home Delivery, Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery or Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | unchanged |
| no handover appointment on record | unchanged |

**Hypothetical cases.** A card allowance of $5850.00 before this adjustment becomes $6250.00 when the vehicle is collected at a Kestrel Hub Pickup, $5350.00 at a Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup, and stays $5850.00 for a Kestrel Local Home Delivery.

When the appointment's fulfillment method changes, the adjustment follows the method now on the appointment.
